canonicalIngredients.name: beef mince
observations: 8 oz sliced beef or ground beef (s0)

canonicalIngredients.name: sesame oil
observations: 2 tsp meat + 1 tbsp sauce + veg seasoning (s0)

causalSequence: cook short grain rice, slightly dry
marinate beef mince in soy, sugar, sesame oil, garlic 20-30 min
blanch spinach and bean sprouts; shock cold, squeeze; season with sesame oil, garlic, salt
julienne carrot, slice mushrooms; saute each separately 2-3 min with salt
stir-fry marinated mince over high heat 3-5 min
mix gochujang, sugar, sesame oil, water into sauce
bowl rice; arrange mince and each vegetable in separate sections; top with egg
serve sauce over or alongside; diner mixes at the table
techniqueFacts: vegetables are prepared and seasoned individually namul-style, never tossed together (3 sources)
spinach and sprouts are blanched then cold-shocked; carrot and mushroom are sauteed (3 sources)
beef gets a bulgogi-style marinade (soy, sugar, sesame oil, garlic) before high-heat cooking (3 sources)
ground beef is an accepted substitute for sliced bulgogi beef, seasoned the same way (1 source, s1 uses mince outright)
sauce base is gochujang loosened with sugar, sesame oil, water; 2 sources add a splash of vinegar
rice cooked slightly drier than usual mixes better (1 source)
season toppings lightly since the gochujang sauce is mixed through everything (1 source)
dolsot (hot stone bowl) variant crisps the bottom rice layer (1 source)
